name: motorical_domain_add
description: Add a customer domain. Returns verification DNS instructions. For cname_managed DKIM publish the CNAME in verification.records.dkim / dnsRecords (not a TXT p= key). On 409 (domain already registered), call motorical_domain_list first to check whether it is already on this account before asking the user to resolve the conflict. A Free account may have one domain; adding another returns free_domain_limit with a nextAction. Over hosted OAuth it needs the manage:domains scope; the local server uses MOTORICAL_JWT. Requires OAuth scope: manage:domains (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_domain_check_dns
description: Live-check DKIM/SPF/DMARC and persist dkim_configured/spf_configured. Required before /v1/send when ownership is verified but send returns DOMAIN_DNS_INCOMPLETE. Over hosted OAuth it needs the manage:domains scope; the local server uses MOTORICAL_JWT. Requires OAuth scope: manage:domains (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_domain_dns_records
description: The DNS records to publish for one domain, with what each is for. Pass lookup:true to also check what DNS currently answers (slower: live lookups). Read-only. Over hosted OAuth it needs the read:domains scope. Requires OAuth scope: read:domains (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_domain_get
description: One domain on this account by id: verified, DNS auth flags, DKIM mode, created. Read-only; no keys or tokens. Over hosted OAuth it needs the read:domains scope. Requires OAuth scope: read:domains (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_domain_health
description: Email-authentication health of ONE domain by id: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, status, issues, and whether the answer is cached (source). Works for a domain that has no Motor Block yet. Same shape as motorical_get_domain_health, which answers for the domain attached to one Motor Block. Pass refresh:true for a live DNS check (slower). A result with source "cache_stale" or refreshing:true is the last stored check (cacheAgeSeconds says how old; can be days): a recheck has started, so read again in about ten seconds or pass refresh:true. dmarc.policy is not reported yet (always null); dmarc.configured says whether a record exists. Read-only. Over hosted OAuth it needs the read:domains scope. Requires OAuth scope: read:domains (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_domain_list
description: List domains already on this account — id, domain, verified, DNS auth flags. Call this before motorical_domain_add on a 409 conflict to self-diagnose whether the domain is already yours (proceed with the existing id) or genuinely owned by someone else (stop, do not guess). Over hosted OAuth it needs the read:domains scope; the local server uses MOTORICAL_JWT. Requires OAuth scope: read:domains (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_domain_verify
description: Verify domain ownership and refresh DKIM/SPF/DMARC send-readiness flags. Requires confirm:true — this call is destructive/consequential. Returns sendReady. Over hosted OAuth it needs the manage:domains scope; the local server uses MOTORICAL_JWT. Requires OAuth scope: manage:domains (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_free_recipient_add
description: Ask a person to allow test email from this account. Sends them a confirmation email with a link; THEY must open it and click the button, and this tool never confirms on their behalf. Until they confirm, a sandbox allowlist refuses sends to that address, and so do the non-sandbox Motor Blocks of a Free account (when Free enforcement is on); a paid account is not affected. Their address is then also allowed for the sandbox. A recipient who clicked "stop" cannot be re-requested; the response is identical either way. The response includes data.recipient with the address and its status (pending until they click, or confirmed if already confirmed); a person must still click the emailed link. Requires OAuth scope manage:recipients (separate from manage:sandbox; an existing sandbox authorization must be re-approved to include it). Requires OAuth scope: manage:recipients (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

annotations.title: Ask a recipient to allow test email

name: motorical_free_recipient_list
description: List the addresses this account has asked to allow test email, with each status (pending, confirmed or stopped), the recipient limit and current usage. The hourly, daily and monthly numbers are the Free-plan caps for non-sandbox Motor Blocks (see limitsNote in the response); a sandbox Motor Block is governed by the sandbox caps shown in motorical_sandbox_status. Requires OAuth scope manage:recipients. Requires OAuth scope: manage:recipients (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_free_recipient_remove
description: Remove an address from this account's test recipients, by the id returned from motorical_free_recipient_list. Requires OAuth scope manage:recipients. Requires OAuth scope: manage:recipients (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_get_account_rate_limits
description: Account-wide send ceiling and current usage across every Motor Block (GET /api/public/v1/account/rate-limits). Account-scoped: no Motor Block needed. Requires OAuth scope: read:analytics (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_get_anomalies
description: Detected sending anomalies for one Motor Block — volume spikes, bounce surges, unusual patterns. Requires OAuth scope: read:analytics (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_get_config
description: Configuration of one Motor Block — its sending domain, limits (as configured) and effectiveLimits (what is enforced now: dailyVolume, hourlyRate and burstLimit, the lower of configured and any reputation throttle, with defaults filled in; burstLimit is a short-window cap that applies to every block even when not configured), delivery settings, and activeAuthMethod ("Password"/"API Key"/"OAuth 2.0"/"mTLS", read-only -- changing it is dashboard-only). Requires OAuth scope: read:domains (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_get_daily_summary
description: Per-day send counts and outcomes for one Motor Block. Rates use the same finalized-recipient definition as motorical_get_overview (rateBasis says so); days with no sends are not returned. Requires OAuth scope: read:analytics (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_get_deliverability
description: Deliverability broken down by recipient domain. Requires OAuth scope: read:analytics (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_get_domain_health
description: DNS and email-authentication health for the Motor Block's sending domain — SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX. This is a set-up status, not a score, and it is separate from the delivery reputation score (motorical_get_reputation), which measures delivery outcomes. A result with source "cache_stale" or refreshing:true is the last stored check (cacheAgeSeconds says how old; can be days): a recheck has started, so read again in about ten seconds or pass refresh:true. dmarc.policy is not reported yet (always null); dmarc.configured says whether a record exists. Requires OAuth scope: read:domains (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_get_error_codes
description: SMTP error codes seen for one Motor Block, with counts and a specific diagnosis for each. Each row has the code, its count, a label and hint saying what it means and what to do, cause (the platform bounce bucket, for example recipient_invalid or policy_block_auth), retryable (temporary failures are retried by the platform), suggestedAction (none, retry, remove or investigate) and lookup. The stored code is basic (550), enhanced (5.7.1) or a bucket (200 accepted with the exact reply not recorded, which includes delivery to a Motorical-hosted mailbox; 400 and 500 when the exact code was not recorded). Counts are the same rows motorical_get_logs returns: to see the messages behind a row, call motorical_get_logs with the row lookup (smtpCode) and read smtpResponse on one message. Requires OAuth scope: read:analytics (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_get_logs
description: Search send logs for one Motor Block. Paginate with cursor. Recipient addresses are masked unless the token carries logs.pii, which OAuth tokens never do. To find failures by cause use smtpCode: the stored code is whatever the receiving server reported, in either form (basic like 550 or enhanced like 5.7.1), so a class such as 5xx (all permanent failures), 4xx (all temporary ones) or a group such as 5.7.x (policy and reputation blocks) is usually what you want; an exact code matches only that exact form. Requires OAuth scope: read:analytics (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_get_message
description: Get a message by send UUID. Auto-mints bearer if needed. Requires OAuth scope: read:analytics (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_get_message_by_smtp_id
description: Look up one message by its SMTP Message-ID header. This is a lookup, not a listing: an exact id is required and at most one message is returned. Use motorical_get_message when you have the internal send UUID instead. Requires OAuth scope: read:analytics (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_get_message_events
description: Get delivery lifecycle events for a message. Requires OAuth scope: read:analytics (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_get_metrics
description: Time-series send metrics for one Motor Block, bucketed by hour or day. Requires OAuth scope: read:analytics (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_get_onboarding_state
description: Where this account stands right now: stage, whether it can actually send (ready_to_send), what's blocking it, and the one next tool to call to move forward (GET /api/public/v1/account/state). Account-scoped: no Motor Block needed. Each blocker carries humanRequired (a person must act) and, where there is one, a nextAction. For an account with no plan and no domain the response also lists two onboarding options, own_domain and sandbox_domain, and a choose rule for picking between them: state the choice and the reason, and the person may override. Confirming recipients by emailed link needs the manage:recipients scope; an existing authorization must be re-approved to include it. Requires OAuth scope: read:domains (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_get_overview
description: Sending overview for one Motor Block over a date range — volume, delivery and bounce rates, and current usage against plan limits. Rates are percentages of finalized recipients (accepted = delivered + processed + complained, plus bounced and failed); "processed" means the receiving server accepted the message, and queued or deferred recipients are counted as pending, not in the rates. totals.accepted, finalized and pending and rates.basis spell this out; generatedAt says when the figures were computed. Its reputation block is the same delivery reputation score as motorical_get_reputation. Requires OAuth scope: read:analytics (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_get_providers
description: Send outcomes grouped by receiving mailbox provider. deliveryRate uses the same finalized-recipient definition as motorical_get_overview (accepted includes processed; rateBasis says so). Requires OAuth scope: read:analytics (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_get_rate_limits
description: Current hourly and daily send usage against this Motor Block's limits. Requires OAuth scope: read:analytics (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_get_reputation
description: Delivery reputation score (0 to 100) for one Motor Block, computed on request from its delivery outcomes over windowDays (the token retention window): 100 minus penalties for bounced, complained and failed recipients. The response says what it is: kind, basis, formula and notTheSameAs. It is not the dashboard Health score (different formula and timeframe), not the internal score behind automatic throttling, and not domain health (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), so those numbers differ by design. Requires OAuth scope: read:analytics (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_get_send_status
description: Check Motorical transactional email HTTP Send API status. No auth required. Requires OAuth scope: read:analytics (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_list_motor_blocks
description: List the Motor Blocks (isolated sending streams) this connection covers: id and name only, of every type, active or not (so marketing and companion blocks appear too). Use it to find a valid motorBlockId. For type, domain, status and management use motorical_motor_block_list (production blocks only); for the account-wide picture including inactive blocks use motorical_get_onboarding_state. Auto-mints a Public API token with ak_live_ on the local server if needed. Requires OAuth scope: read:analytics (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_mint_public_token
description: Mint a short-lived Public Analytics API bearer token using MOTORICAL_AK_API_KEY (ak_live_...) or, when none is configured, MOTORICAL_JWT. Use for /api/public/v1 logs, analytics, webhooks, config. Not for POST /v1/send.

name: motorical_motor_block_assign_domain
description: Assign a different verified production domain to a Motor Block. The block is reactivated on the new domain; verify sendReady before sending. Requires OAuth scope: manage:motor-blocks (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_motor_block_change_type
description: Change a production Motor Block between transactional and general_purpose. This changes the intended traffic classification, not credentials. Requires OAuth scope: manage:motor-blocks (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_motor_block_create
description: Create a production Motor Block on a verified customer domain. Use transactional for triggered, user-specific mail; use general_purpose for mixed operational sending. Hosted OAuth never returns passwords or API-key secrets. A UUID-v4 idempotencyKey makes retries return the original result. The domainId must be a verified, non-sandbox domain the account owns; a narrow Motor Blocks server cannot list or add domains, so get it from motorical_domain_list (on the main server, or the Domains server); add and verify one first with motorical_domain_add / motorical_domain_verify if the account has none. Requires OAuth scope: manage:motor-blocks (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_motor_block_deactivate
description: Deactivate (pause) a production Motor Block. This is reversible and does not delete history or credentials; sending stops until reactivated. Requires OAuth scope: manage:motor-blocks (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_motor_block_delete
description: Permanently delete an inactive Motor Block asynchronously. This is irrecoverable. Set deleteHistory explicitly; then poll the returned job with motorical_motor_block_delete_status. Requires OAuth scope: manage:motor-blocks (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_motor_block_delete_status
description: Read the current state and final report for an asynchronous permanent Motor Block deletion job. Requires OAuth scope: manage:motor-blocks (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_motor_block_list
description: List ordinary production Motor Blocks (isolated sending streams) this account can manage. Includes inactive blocks so they can be reactivated; excludes sandboxes, marketing, and portal-managed companion blocks, so its count can be lower than motorical_list_motor_blocks (which lists every block this connection covers, id and name only). Prefer this one when you need type, domain or status. Requires OAuth scope: manage:motor-blocks (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_motor_block_reactivate
description: Reactivate a previously deactivated production Motor Block. A verified production domain is required. Requires OAuth scope: manage:motor-blocks (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_motor_block_rename
description: Rename a production Motor Block for display and organization. This never changes its SMTP username, password, API keys, or auth method. Requires OAuth scope: manage:motor-blocks (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_sandbox_allowlist_confirm
description: NOT AVAILABLE over hosted OAuth (dashboard session only): use motorical_free_recipient_add instead. Confirm a sandbox allowlist recipient using the 6-digit code sent by motorical_sandbox_allowlist_request. On success the address is added to the allowlist and can receive real (non-dryRun) sandbox sends. Requires MOTORICAL_JWT. Requires OAuth scope: manage:sandbox (see motorical_whoami for what it allows). Needs a dashboard session, not OAuth — granting this scope does not make this tool callable over a hosted OAuth/Delegation connection.

name: motorical_sandbox_allowlist_request
description: NOT AVAILABLE over hosted OAuth (dashboard session only): use motorical_free_recipient_add instead. Request to add a new recipient to the developer sandbox outbound allowlist. Sends a 6-digit confirmation code to that address (not the account owner) — call motorical_sandbox_allowlist_confirm with the code the recipient receives. Requires MOTORICAL_JWT. Requires OAuth scope: manage:sandbox (see motorical_whoami for what it allows). Needs a dashboard session, not OAuth — granting this scope does not make this tool callable over a hosted OAuth/Delegation connection.

name: motorical_sandbox_convert
description: Convert sandbox Motor Block onto a verified customer domain (the target must be a verified real domain, never a .sandbox domain). A sandbox that already sits on your own verified domain converts onto that same domain, which needs no DNS change. Requires an active Motorical plan -- if none exists, this call throws with err.data.code === "subscription_required" and err.data.upgradeUrl naming where a human can subscribe; retry this same call once they have. If no sandbox exists yet (check motorical_sandbox_status first -- data.stage: "not_started"), call motorical_sandbox_provision instead; this endpoint returns 404 "No developer sandbox to convert" otherwise. The response always includes activeAuthMethod (the Motor Block's configured auth method -- "Password", "API Key", "OAuth 2.0", or "mTLS" -- read-only, changing it is dashboard-only). Conversion is a production identity transition: choose name/type or accept backend defaults; the SMTP username changes, so SMTP clients must be updated, while the existing SMTP password, API keys, and auth method remain unchanged. Over hosted OAuth it also includes credentialsLocation, a link to the dashboard where the customer can view or regenerate the actual credential value -- this tool never returns the raw value itself. Requires OAuth scope: manage:sandbox (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_sandbox_provision
description: Provision the unpaid developer sandbox on a Motorical-owned .sandbox domain (Path 1: instant, no DNS) with an outbound-locked Motor Block. A Free account that adds and fully verifies its own domain (Path 2) gets a sandbox Motor Block on that domain automatically once DKIM and SPF pass, with no provisioning call, when automatic provisioning is enabled; if none appears on its own, call this tool (it creates one on the Motorical-owned domain). Over hosted OAuth, this NEVER returns credentials -- the response has credentialsAvailable:false instead. The new Motor Block is added to the live authorization and is immediately usable by explicit id, without refreshing an access token minted before provisioning. Credentials become available via a dashboard link after motorical_sandbox_convert. Only the local @motorical/mcp stdio server (dashboard-JWT auth) still returns mk_live_ once, since it is the customer's own long-running process on their own infrastructure -- securing whatever it returns is the customer's own responsibility on that path. Requires OAuth scope: manage:sandbox (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_sandbox_status
description: Get developer sandbox status (domain, Motor Block, outbound lock, allowlist). Check data.stage to determine provisioning state: "not_started" (no sandbox yet — call motorical_sandbox_provision), "sandbox_active" (sandbox exists, outbound-locked), or "live" (converted to production, no lock). allowlist/caps are always present in the response regardless of stage — do not infer provisioning state from their presence. The allowlist is the EFFECTIVE list: sandbox recipients, link-confirmed recipients, the account address and the test sink, minus any address that clicked stop. domain.sandbox true means the Motorical-owned sandbox domain; domain.sandbox false means your own domain. outboundLocked true means real sends are limited to the allowlist, not that nothing can be sent; outboundLocked is null when no sandbox exists yet (nothing to lock). Requires OAuth scope: manage:sandbox (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_send_email
description: Send a transactional email, or validate one first. Defaults to dryRun:true: a dry run returns the resolved from, subject, recipient count and body size, plus `limits` (burst, hourly and daily: used, limit, remaining, reset) and `warnings` (stable codes such as NO_TEXT_PART, SUBJECT_LONG, OVER_LIMIT, NEAR_LIMIT, THROTTLED), so "validated" is not read as "would work". Real sends require dryRun:false AND confirmRealSend:true. Over the hosted OAuth server your grant authorizes the send and you never see a key; the local stdio server instead needs MOTORICAL_MK_API_KEY (mk_live_...). A real send returns two different ids: messageId (use it with motorical_get_message and motorical_get_message_events) and nextAction.args.taskId (use it ONLY with motorical_wait_for_outcome). Neither works in the other tool. from must be an address at the domain your Motor Block is assigned to: a verified, send-ready domain you own, or the Motorical-owned sandbox domain from motorical_sandbox_provision (see motorical_get_onboarding_state sendFrom); any local part works. Sandbox accounts only: real sends go only to the effective allowlist (see motorical_sandbox_status); a non-allowlisted recipient is refused (403 sandbox_outbound_locked or sandbox_recipient_denied), never redirected, so unlock it with motorical_free_recipient_add first. Those two tools disappear once the account has a verified domain and an active plan, so ignore this sentence if you cannot see them. cc, bcc, replyTo, headers and attachments are optional; each field says its own limits and errors. Requires OAuth scope: send:transactional (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_wait_for_outcome
description: Wait for a real send's actual delivery outcome (not just the 202 acceptance). Bounded server-side wait with backoff, capped under typical client timeouts. If the result is still_pending, wait retryAfterMs and call this again with the same taskId. Requires OAuth scope: read:analytics (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_web_handoff
description: Mint a one-time browser handoff URL. Open the URL so the human can set a dashboard password / use the UI. Requires MOTORICAL_JWT. Give the person the link as a short markdown link such as [Open your Motorical dashboard](url), never as a bare long URL. The link is short-lived (the response has expiresInSeconds): open it right away; if it says expired, ask for a new link or sign in with your password.

name: motorical_webhook_create
description: Register a new webhook endpoint on one Motor Block. The response includes the full signing secret exactly once — store it immediately, it is only masked on every later read. Requires OAuth scope: manage:webhooks (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_webhook_delete
description: Delete a webhook endpoint. Requires OAuth scope: manage:webhooks (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_webhook_get_deliveries
description: Recent delivery attempts for one webhook endpoint. Requires OAuth scope: read:webhooks (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_webhook_get_stats
description: Delivery success/failure counts and average latency for one webhook endpoint over a time window. Requires OAuth scope: read:webhooks (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_webhook_list
description: List webhook endpoints registered on one Motor Block. Requires OAuth scope: read:webhooks (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_webhook_test
description: Send a synthetic test delivery to a webhook endpoint. Requires OAuth scope: manage:webhooks (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_webhook_update
description: Update a webhook endpoint's url, events, or enabled state. Only the fields you pass are changed. Requires OAuth scope: manage:webhooks (see motorical_whoami for what it allows).

name: motorical_whoami
description: Who this connection is acting for: the account (id, owner email, name), its plan (name, status, hasSubscription), account.billing (price amount in minor units + currency + interval, trial end, current period end / next renewal date, cancelAtPeriodEnd and endsAt, this month's sends against the plan cap, and paymentMethod.status ok or failing; never invoices, receipts or card details; a field it cannot resolve is null with its reason under billing.unavailable) and, for an OAuth connection, the grant: the client, the scopes it holds, the Motor Blocks it covers, when it was granted, and canAdd (permissions it could still be given, with available:false where the plan does not allow it) plus addInDashboard, the page where the person adds them. Account-scoped: no Motor Block needed. grant is null when the call is not made over an OAuth grant. Over OAuth it needs no scope, so any connection can ask what it holds, and every server lists it. Use it instead of inferring scopes from the tool list.
